description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class, testing its notification handling capabilities, including authorization checks, input validation, and error handling.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the SystemHandler class, verifying proper handling of system notifications with various inputs and error scenarios.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster used for testing, simulating posting notifications with success.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster that simulates failure by throwing exceptions during post attempts.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that unauthorized requests are rejected with proper error code.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Tests that empty notification fields result in rejection and validation.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests handling of malformed or incomplete request objects.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Verifies that a properly formed request results in a notification post and success.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Checks that optional fields are trimmed and passed correctly to the poster.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Ensures that permission-related errors during posting return an 'NOT_AUTHORIZED' error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Verifies that unexpected errors during posting return an 'UNAVAILABLE' error with details.
